# Kiralyte Technology Solutions

> Software Engineering, AI Automation & Data-Backed Growth Agency founded by Abdulrasaq Shuaib.

Kiralyte Technology Solutions pairs full-stack software development with data-backed marketing under one team so founders never stall at a technology or marketing wall. What we build gets seen, and what gets seen gets measured and improved.

## Core Specialties & Deliverables
- **Mobile Apps (iOS & Android):** End-to-end engineering, UX/UI, App Store launch, and Google Play launch.
- **Responsive Websites & SaaS MVPs:** High-converting websites, e-commerce storefronts, and scalable cloud SaaS platforms.
- **SEO, GEO & AEO:** Technical Search Engine Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization (AI search citations), and Answer Engine Optimization (featured snippets and zero-click answers).
- **Organic & Paid Growth Campaigns:** Full-funnel customer acquisition across Google, Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and LinkedIn.
- **AI Systems & Workflow Automation:** Custom AI agents, voice/chat assistants, CRM integrations, and automated operational pipelines.
